description: Two header bodies by one author with one operation ID and clock at one path, differing only in `level` (in the AAD, not in the ID). Fold order is (clock, author, id) with the body digest, lowest first, as the last tie-break: the lowest digest is admitted and the other is refused duplicateID, whichever arrives first. Both are admitted at step 8 and reserve one slot (one distinct (author, id)).
